title: Finiteness of Hadamard ranks
summary: The Hadamard rank of a point with respect to a projective variety is, if it exists, the minimum number of points of the variety whose coordinate-wise product is the given point. We classify the projective varieties for which the Hadamard rank is finite for any point. As a by-product we obtain the finiteness of the Hadamard rank with respect to varieties of tensors, such as Grassmannians, Chow varieties, varieties of reducible forms and their secant varieties, complementing previous known results on secant varieties of Segre-Veronese varieties.
